input.rationale: Governing law is Delaware (Section 13.6.1), which sits at our fallback. However, the Agreement designates no court forum at all: Section 13.6 is captioned \"Jurisdiction\" but contains only a service provision referring to \"any such court,\" and Section 13.7.1 lets either Party elect binding arbitration under Schedule 13.7.3, whose seat and rules are redacted. The fallback requires the corresponding Delaware courts as the dispute forum, so the forum element fails materially. Our single edit routes unresolved Disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Delaware state and federal courts, leaving the Delaware governing law, the Senior Officer step, the IP carve-out in 13.7.2 and the interim-relief carve-out in 13.7.5 untouched.

proposal.summary: Replace the party-elected arbitration route with exclusive litigation in the Delaware state and federal courts, matching the Delaware governing law already selected.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Delaware law is acceptable to us, but the Agreement designates no court forum and instead lets either Party push any Dispute into arbitration under a schedule whose seat is not stated. We have conformed the forum to our fallback position by routing unresolved Disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in Delaware.
